assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management
The payer's denial is under CO-22
The denial asserts that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with Coordination of Benefits protocols
The denial requires the primary payer's Explanation of Benefits before Meridian Health assumes responsibility
The clinical indication supports medical necessity of the mobile telemetry service
The service was medically necessary to capture and interpret the patient's recurrent symptomatic arrhythmias
